description: This file is an HTML document that serves as a frontend interface for a database viewer application. It includes the structure and styles for displaying a list of databases, tables, and table data, along with embedded JavaScript code for dynamic fetching and rendering of database information.

methods.name: loadDatabases
methods.description: Fetches the list of available databases from the backend API and renders them in the sidebar.

methods.name: refreshDatabases
methods.description: Refreshes the database list, resetting current selections and fetching the latest data.

methods.name: toggleDatabase
methods.description: Expands or collapses the list of tables for a selected database and initiates loading tables.

methods.name: loadTables
methods.description: Fetches and displays the list of tables for a selected database.

methods.name: loadTableData
methods.description: Fetches and displays data from a specific table within a database.

methods.name: renderTable
methods.description: Renders the table data into HTML, including headers and rows.

methods.name: renderCell
methods.description: Creates HTML for individual cell content, handling objects, long text, and nulls.

methods.name: expandCell
methods.description: Expands or collapses cell content for better viewing, especially for long or object data.
